other_conditions: Applicant must have a disability of 40% or above.
Applicant must be 18 years or older.
Applicant must not be employed in government or government‑affiliated organizations.
If employed permanently in the private sector or self‑employed, annual income must not exceed ₹3,00,000.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 plus free clothing (dhoti for males, saree for females) and free rice through Anganwadi centres.
